title: test-image
description: A woman pouring coffee in a quiet sunlit café, completely absorbed in this one small ritual — as if this moment is the whole day. Golden-hour light falls softly across her hands, the steam rising slowly like a breath. You can almost feel the warmth of the cup, the unhurried stillness of the afternoon. Over-the-shoulder close-up, intimate and tender. Worn wooden table, muted earth tones — terracotta, honey, dusty linen. Loose watercolor illustration, soft bleeding edges, visible brushstrokes, gentle bokeh fading into a warm blurred world behind her
